description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_Filter` that represents a filter used in the HTML Purifier library for processing HTML content. It provides methods for pre-processing and post-processing HTML during purification, and serves as a base or abstract class for custom filters within the library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter
classes.description: A class representing a filter in the HTML Purifier library responsible for pre- and post-processing HTML content during purification.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: A method intended to handle or modify HTML before HTML Purifier processes it. Default implementation returns the input HTML unchanged.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: A method intended to handle or modify HTML after HTML Purifier processes it. Default implementation returns the input HTML unchanged.
